name: nidus
title: Nidus
description: A Markdown-based, local-first Raycast extension for capturing thoughts in Nidus projects.
author: kumare_agape

preferences.name: vaultPath
preferences.title: Vault Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to auto-detect the vault from the Nidus app.

commands.name: quick-capture
commands.title: Capture
commands.subtitle: Nidus
commands.description: Enter a project and capture a thought directly in its Inbox.

commands.name: manage-aliases
commands.title: Manage Project Aliases
commands.subtitle: Nidus
commands.description: Assign short aliases that enter Nidus projects instantly.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
